basic_details.job_title: Akashvani Dehradun Part Time Correspondent Recruitment 2026 – Apply Offline
basic_details.short_information: Akashvani Dehradun (Prasar Bharati) has notified 1 vacancy for the Part-Time Correspondent (PTC) post on a contract basis, with applications to be sent by registered post to The Head of Office Akashvani, Dehradun P.O. Ajabpur Kalan on or before 31 October 2026. Eligible applicants must possess a PG Diploma/Degree in Journalism/Mass Media or graduation with a minimum of two years of journalistic experience. The notified pay is Rs. 10,000, and the selection process includes an interview covering professional experience, current affairs, and writing skills, followed by performance monitoring.

content_sections.heading: Prasar Bharati Part-Time Correspondent (PTC) at a Glance

rows.details: Rs. 10,000/- per month (including conveyance and telephone charges)
PG Diploma/Degree in Journalism/Mass Media OR Graduation with 2 years of journalistic experience

content_sections.heading: Where and How to Send
content_sections.text: Applications must be sent in the prescribed format, along with self-attested copies of the required documents and one recent photograph, by registered post to the following address: The Head of Office Akashvani, Dehradun P.O. Ajabpur Kalan – 248001

content_sections.heading: Posts, Eligibility and Pay
content_sections.text: PG Diploma/Degree in Journalism/Mass Media or graduation with a minimum of two years of journalistic experience. Must reside at the respective district headquarters or within a radius of 10 km from the district headquarters/municipal limit in the district for which the candidate is being engaged. Knowledge of computers and word processing. Possession of news-gathering devices. Experience in covering news for electronic media.

content_sections.heading: Enclosures
content_sections.text: Self-attested age-proof document (Aadhaar, SSLC certificate, PAN card or driving licence/photo ID). Self-attested address-proof document. Self-attested copies of relevant qualification certificates, including degree, PG diploma and experience certificates.

content_sections.heading: Selection Process
content_sections.text: Selection will involve an interview. Candidates will be assessed on qualifications and professional experience, knowledge of the district and state, current affairs, awareness of Central Government welfare schemes, familiarity with radio news, journalistic aptitude and writing skills, and familiarity with communication technologies. Initially, the candidate's performance will be monitored for three months, with the contract renewed monthly during this period. If performance is satisfactory, a yearly contract may be offered until the candidate reaches 60 years of age.

faq.question: Q1. Is this position permanent or on contract?
faq.answer: Part-Time Correspondents will be engaged on a contractual retainership basis initially monitored for three months, with yearly contract renewals upon satisfactory performance up to 60 years of age.

faq.question: Q2. Who is ineligible to apply for this position?
faq.answer: Persons already employed in Central/State Government or Union Territory Administration service, or employed by a Public Sector Undertaking (PSU), and members of any political party will not be considered.

faq.question: Q3. What are the desirable qualifications for the PTC post?
faq.answer: Experience in covering news for electronic media is listed as a desirable qualification.

faq.question: Q4. Which documents are required to be attached with the application?
faq.answer: Applicants must attach a self-attested age-proof document, a self-attested address-proof document, and self-attested copies of relevant qualification certificates, including degrees, PG diplomas, and experience certificates.
